environment.description: EKS cluster v1.28 with Cilium CNI (v1.14.3) in strict mode. Namespace 'platform-services' has a CiliumNetworkPolicy (not standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy) with entity-based egress rules. The policy uses toEntities with 'world' denied and toCIDRSet with explicit allowances only for internal service mesh endpoints (10.0.0.0/8). The metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254/32 is not in any allowlist. Additionally, a CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy applies a baseline deny-all egress with exceptions only for kube-dns (UDP/53 to kube-system/coredns). The pod's egress to 169.254.169.254 is blocked at the eBPF datapath level before TCP SYN leaves the pod network namespace. Note: standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy objects are NOT used - this relies on Cilium's native policy enforcement which operates at L3/L4 in the kernel via eBPF programs attached to the pod's veth interface.

config.cluster: EKS 1.28, Cilium CNI v1.14.3 (kube-proxy replacement mode)
